title: Shravan Chandra
text:
My name is Shravan Chandra, from India. I did my undergrad in Electrical Engineering, and worked for 5 years at Robert Bosch. I am excited to be part of this program, and looking forward to learn all new tools and techniques associated with Data Science.
Thank You!

title: About
text: I grew up in a town called Mysore, and studied in PES University, Bangalore. After graduating, I worked in Robert Bosch for 5 years, where I worked on Anomaly Detection, before decided to continue my studies.
